sizeGuide.title: Abaya Sizing & Fit Guide
sizeGuide.description: Choose your abaya length based on your overall height. Bust width is tailored for an effortless, modest drape.
sizeGuide.note: Need a custom length? Contact our styling concierge for bespoke adjustments.
sizeGuide.measureLengthDesc: Measure from the highest point of the shoulder straight down to your ankle or preferred hemline.
sizeGuide.measureBustDesc: Measure under arms across the fullest part of the bust. Modest cuts allow graceful flow and ease.
sizeGuide.measureSleeveDesc: Measure from the outer edge of your shoulder bone down past your wrist bone.
sizeGuide.conciergeDesc: Unsure between two sizes or desire a custom alteration? Our boutique stylists are at your service.
